config.rasterization: OpenILT full 2048 inclusive fillPoly; point sample full[::stride,::stride]
config.loss: mean over 3 corners of squared sigmoid-resist error / target foreground pixels
config.selection_loss: mean over 3 corners of hard wafer XOR target pixel count
config.candidate_tie_break: earliest checkpoint; repaired selector prefers valid candidates
config.compute_fairness: robust variants share same gradient trajectory and candidate pool; repair/forward overhead reported separately; not equal wall time
